content_sections.heading: BEL Management Industrial Trainee Vacancy 2026
content_sections.text: The number of Management Industrial Trainee vacancies is not specified in the official notification . The notification only states that statutory reservation will be applied as per Government norms during selection.

content_sections.heading: BEL Management Industrial Trainee Eligibility 2026
content_sections.text: Important: Candidates who do not possess a CMA (Intermediate) pass or CA (Intermediate) pass certificate are not eligible to appear for this walk-in interview.

rows.details: Must have passed CMA (Intermediate) or CA (Intermediate)
Candidates who have already acquired, or are currently pursuing, a higher qualification are NOT eligible

content_sections.heading: BEL Management Industrial Trainee Age Limit
content_sections.text: Note: The relaxed maximum ages for OBC, SC/ST and PwD categories above are calculated by adding the stated relaxation to the 25-year general upper age limit; the notification states the relaxation years but does not separately restate the resulting maximum age for each category.

content_sections.heading: BEL Management Industrial Trainee Stipend & Benefits
content_sections.text: Free OPD medical treatment at the BEL hospital, as per company norms Group Personal Accident Insurance cover for a sum insured of ₹5,00,000 Canteen facility, provided on a chargeable basis Transport facility, provided on a chargeable basis Subsidized accommodation for outstation candidates only, subject to availability and on a chargeable basis; candidates must otherwise arrange their own stay

content_sections.heading: BEL Management Industrial Trainee Selection Process
content_sections.text: Selection is purely on the basis of performance in both academics and the interview. Statutory reservation is applied as per Government norms. Selected candidates will be informed through e-mail, followed by publication of the selected candidates' list on the BEL website. No TA/DA (travel or dearness allowance) will be paid to candidates appearing for the selection process.

content_sections.heading: BEL MIT Walk-In Interview Details
content_sections.text: There is no online or postal application for this recruitment. Eligible candidates should report in person on the interview date with the required documents: Important: Carry one set of photocopies of all required documents along with originals for verification. No TA/DA is payable for attending the interview.

rows.information: Centre for Learning and Development, Bharat Electronics Limited, Jalahalli, Bengaluru – 560013

content_sections.heading: Documents Required (1 Set of Photocopies)
content_sections.text: SSLC marks card Degree certificate CMA (Intermediate) / CA (Intermediate) passed certificate Aadhaar card Note: Candidates must produce the ORIGINAL CMA (Intermediate) / CA (Intermediate) pass certificate issued by the competent authority at the time of verification.

content_sections.heading: Important Conditions
content_sections.text: Only Indian Nationals who have passed CMA (Intermediate) or CA (Intermediate) are eligible; candidates who have acquired or are pursuing higher qualifications are not eligible. Suppression of facts or furnishing false information will lead to disqualification or rejection of candidature. Canvassing in any form will result in disqualification. No TA/DA will be paid to candidates appearing for the selection process. The initial training tenure is one year; an extension of one more year may be considered after reviewing the candidate's performance, and the total tenure including extension shall be a maximum of three years.

faq.question: Q1. Do I need to apply online for BEL MIT 2026?
faq.answer: No. This is a walk-in recruitment – eligible candidates report directly for the interview with the required documents; there is no online or postal application.

faq.question: Q2. When and where is the walk-in interview?
faq.answer: 10 September 2026 at 9:00 AM, at the Centre for Learning and Development, BEL, Jalahalli, Bengaluru – 560013.

faq.question: Q3. What is the educational qualification required?
faq.answer: A pass in CMA (Intermediate) or CA (Intermediate); candidates who already hold or are pursuing a higher qualification are not eligible.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit?
faq.answer: Maximum 25 years as on 1 September 2026, with relaxation of 5 years for SC/ST, 3 years for OBC, and 10 years for persons with disabilities.

faq.question: Q5. What is the stipend for MIT?
faq.answer: ₹25,000 per month in the 1st year, ₹27,000 in the 2nd year, and ₹30,000 in the 3rd year.

faq.question: Q6. How long is the MIT training tenure?
faq.answer: Initially one year, extendable by one more year based on performance, for a maximum total tenure of three years.
